lines.speaker: Gus
lines.text: Hello again! It is me, Gus. Look up at the <color=red>stars</color>!

lines.speaker: Gus
lines.text: My space story lost five words. Can you <color=red>fill</color> the gaps? Then the library gets five new books!

lines.speaker: Gus
lines.text:
Missing word 1:
At night, I see the <color=red>_____</color> in the sky.
lines.hint: Not quite. What shines in the sky at night?
lines.correctText: At night, I see the <color=red>moon</color> in the sky.

lines.speaker: Gus
lines.text:
Missing word 2:
The sun is a big, hot <color=red>_____</color>.
lines.hint: Not quite. The sun is in the sky. What else is up there?
lines.correctText: The sun is a big, hot <color=red>star</color>.

lines.speaker: Gus
lines.text:
Missing word 3:
We live on a planet called <color=red>_____</color>.
lines.hint: Not quite. What is the name of our home planet?
lines.correctText: We live on a planet called <color=red>Earth</color>.

lines.speaker: Gus
lines.text:
Missing word 4:
An astronaut flies up into space in a <color=red>_____</color>.
lines.hint: Not quite. What can fly up very high?
lines.correctText: An astronaut flies up into space in a <color=red>rocket</color>.

lines.speaker: Gus
lines.text:
Missing word 5:
Astronauts wear a <color=red>_____</color> on their heads to stay safe.
lines.hint: Not quite. What keeps your head safe?
lines.correctText: Astronauts wear a <color=red>helmet</color> on their heads to stay safe.

lines.speaker: Gus
lines.text: You found all five words! Five new <color=red>books</color> are going to the library!

afterLines.speaker: Gus
afterLines.text: Thank you for my space story. Look up tonight and wave at the <color=red>moon</color>!
